arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Karlan argued that firing a man for dating men violates Title VII.
General Francisco argued that sex means male or female, not sexual orientation.
Chief Justice Roberts asked how to handle policies applying equally to men and women.
Justice Ginsburg noted differences in prison guard demographics.
